name: Array sorting
description: Sorting arrays is traditionally associated with high-level languages. How hard can it be in Befunge? Sort the given array in non-descending order.
input_specification: The first line of input contains an integer n ( 1 ≤ n ≤ 100 ) — the size of the array. The following n lines contain the elements of the array, one per line. Each element of the array is an integer between 1 and 60 , inclusive. The array might contain duplicate elements.
output_specification: Output space-separated elements of the sorted array.
subsubtopic: 42. C++ STL Sort and Custom Comparator
approach_summary: Apply C++ STL Sort and Custom Comparator paradigm under the Basics framework. Exploit problem invariants to reduce state space and achieve optimal complexity.
